_comment: Feedback templates. Each key holds one or more variants; the variant is chosen deterministically from the hand seed, so replaying a seed reads identically. Placeholders in {braces} are filled with values computed by the engine — no text here is generated at runtime.

{outs} outs, {street}. Exact is {exact}%; the shortcut gives {rule}%. You answered {given}%.
EQUITY_UNDER: You judged {given}; you were {truth} — {percent}% against his range. You are counting only the times you improve and ignoring the {asIs}% you already win with {category}.
{given} is a band too low. True equity is {percent}%, which is {truth}. Your hand wins {asIs}% of the time without improving at all.
EQUITY_OVER: You judged {given}; you were {truth} — {percent}% against his range. Counting outs assumes every one of them wins; against this range they do not.
{given} is a band too high. True equity is {percent}%, which is {truth}.
EQUITY_SOURCE: Where it comes from: {asIs} points from {category} already being good, {improved} points from improving. You improve {improveRate}% of the time.
Breakdown: {asIs}% as-is with {category}, plus {improved}% from improving on {improveRate}% of runouts.
POT_ODDS_ARITHMETIC: Pot odds are arithmetic, not estimation: {call} to call into {pot} is {call}/{total} = {truth}%. You said {given}%.
You said {given}%; it is {truth}%. Calling {call} into {pot} means risking {call} to win {total}.
ACTION_SHOULD_FOLD: You chose {given}, but folding is correct here: {equity}% equity against a {potOdds}% price, with no fold equity to make up the difference.
This is a fold. {equity}% equity does not meet the {potOdds}% the price demands, and {given} only puts in more.
ACTION_TOO_PASSIVE: You chose {given}; {best} is better. With {equity}% equity and the opponent folding {foldEquity}% of the time, there is more value in putting chips in.
{given} leaves value behind. {best} is correct: {equity}% equity plus {foldEquity}% fold equity.
ACTION_TOO_AGGRESSIVE: You chose {given}; {best} is better. {equity}% equity does not justify the extra chips when the opponent folds only {foldEquity}% of the time.
{given} overplays this. {best} is correct — fold equity is only {foldEquity}%.
TIMEOUT: Time ran out. The hand counts as a loss regardless of what was entered.
Timer expired before the hand was answered.
CORRECT: Every field right. {equity}% equity, and {action} is the play.
All correct. {equity}% equity, {action} is the play.
